title: phleum boehmeri var. ciliatum
intro: Phleum boehmeri var. ciliatum, commonly known as ciliated timothy grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It has been traditionally used in medicine to treat various health issues due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Phleum boehmeri var. ciliatum include soothing and calming effects, as well as potential anti-inflammatory actions, which may help alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues and skin conditions. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
